title: SOPS global MAC mismatch
brief: Argo CD cannot render the latest encrypted configuration. Find the comparison error.

checks.question: Which Application has the comparison error?
checks.hint: Filter the Applications list by environment.
checks.why: The list identifies the broken release.

checks.question: Which SOPS integrity field mismatched?
checks.hint: Read the field named in Conditions.
checks.why: Conditions show why Argo could not render desired manifests.

truth.cause: The SOPS global MAC no longer matches the encrypted values
